## LidoLendMarketController #11

Inverts the heap sift-up so low risk keys rise.

+++ b/src/libs/MaxHeapLib.sol
@@ -130,7 +130,7 @@
     function _siftUp(Heap storage self, uint256 idx) private returns (uint256) {
         while (idx > 1) {
             uint256 parent = idx >> 1;
-            if (self.nodes[idx].key <= self.nodes[parent].key) break;
+            if (self.nodes[idx].key >= self.nodes[parent].key) break;
             _swap(self, idx, parent);
             idx = parent;

-        if (effectiveInflow >= maxDelayInflow) return maxActivationDelay;
+        if (effectiveInflow >= maxDelayInflow) return minActivationDelay;
